source: Seckin 20:14, 16 November 2026: a single Lambda step up to 5 USD needs no question, above 5 USD goes to him; the remaining-spend limit of D-599 rises from 120 to 140 USD
counted: Lambda spend only, by the reaper's own reading of the ledgers the guard reads (instance_reaper.ledger_view), plus the running caps, the storage forecast, the overrun reserve and the forecast of the launch asked for; the API spend has its own ceiling in the spend store (D-S121) and is not counted here. The baseline is the spend D-599 is counted from (FOR_SECKIN 16 Nov 17:34: 197 USD on 13 November; the reaper's reading at 13 Nov 09:37 UTC, the time of D-599, is 197.94 USD, so 197 is the lower, safer figure). The guard admits a launch only while baseline + limit (337 USD) is not passed.
step_rule: The step is the launch's IV.3 forecast (the measured basis x the live price x 1.3). A forecast at or below step_preapproved_usd is admitted with no question; above it the launch needs the operator's approval of at least the forecast, naming its decision (loop_budget_guard.step_rule). The per-run cap may still reach 1.5 x the forecast, as IV.3 has it.
